stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first trilateral summit
stories.summary: The three leaders met for 90 minutes on the APEC sidelines and issued a “Declaration toward Peace” on nuclear risk and energy. No agreement on Ukraine was announced.

stories.headline: World Court rules 9–6 Myanmar breached genocide convention
stories.summary: The ICJ found Myanmar violated the Genocide Convention over the Rohingya and ordered reparations. Myanmar's junta rejected the ruling.

stories.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil fuels and $120bn aid goal

stories.headline: Africa instant payments hit $1.8tn
stories.summary: Instant payment systems in Africa processed 71.4 billion transactions worth $1.8 trillion in 2025, the SIIPS 2026 report launched Thursday in Mauritius said.

stories.headline: Barça women rout Servette 6–0
stories.summary: Clàudia Pina's hat-trick helped Barcelona beat Servette 6-0 to reach the Women's Champions League quarter-finals for the 12th season running.

stories.headline: India–Japan sign defence pact
stories.summary: At their fourth 2+2 meeting in Tokyo, India and Japan signed a letter of intent for Japanese live-fire training at Indian ranges under 'Design with Japan, Make in India'.

stories.headline: Pulsar found spinning 261× a second
stories.summary: A cryptography-inspired lattice method found pulsar PSR J1622-7204 in 15 years of NASA Fermi data in about 10 hours of computing; results published Thursday in Physical Review Letters.
